use_cases: Continuous acoustic insulation unrolled in commercial steel stud partitions
Acoustic sound absorption in multi-residential drywall cavity walls
retrieval.rag_summary:
Ecowool Acoustic Partition
Roll represents glass mineral wool acoustic insulation supplied in roll format
for friction-fitting in steel and timber stud partition walls. In Australia, PGF
Insulation / Ecowool supplies its acoustic partition range primarily in pre-cut
batts (Acoustic Partition Batts and NoiseBreak), with rolls primarily designated
for HVAC and reflective roof blankets. When specified, partition rolls provide
continuous, joint-free acoustic and thermal insulation to control speech
transmission in commercial and residential walls.
